role_voices.text_zh: 維持秩序是作為風紀股長應該做的事。
role_voices.text_en: As the Hall Monitor, it is my job to maintain order.

role_voices.text_zh: 看什麼看！你日常做完了嗎？！
role_voices.text_en: What are you looking at? Have you finished your dailies yet?!

role_voices.text_zh: 嗶、嗶——好感度不夠就想色色！？給我到旁邊罰站！
role_voices.text_en: Beep, beep— Not enough affection for sex scenes?! Go and stand in the corner!

role_voices.text_zh: 唔啊……我沒有想睡覺！我只是昨天開台開太晚了……
role_voices.text_en: Yawn... I'm not sleepy right now! I just live-streamed too late last night...

role_voices.text_zh: 今天沒有遲到哦，要繼續保持下去哦！
role_voices.text_en: You weren't late today, be sure to keep this up!

role_voices.text_zh: 這個是……鑰匙？這些都是從哪裡來的？你是鑰匙生產器嗎？
role_voices.text_en: Are these... keys? Where did these come from? Are you some kind of key-making machine?

role_voices.text_zh: 乖乖上課的獎勵？那麼就給你摸摸頭吧！
role_voices.text_en: A reward for behaving in class? How about I give you a head pat?

role_voices.text_zh: 枕頭？我沒有隨身攜帶這種東西欸，胸部就借你躺吧。
role_voices.text_en: A pillow? I don't bring that kind of stuff with me, how about you let me use your chest as one?

role_voices.text_zh: 什麼邋遢，我只是比較懂享受生活！
role_voices.text_en: Who are you calling sloppy?! I'm just better at enjoying life!
Are you trying to drive me crazy?!

role_voices.text_zh: 果然堅持就會看到希望！
role_voices.text_en: I knew it! If you persevere, you will see hope!
